depictions.name: La Claire
depictions.text: La Claire was a sandy beach located northwest of Marais-Vernier in Evresin, Francia. During Eivor Varinsdottir's travels in Francia, at the time of the second Viking siege of Paris, she visited the location and erected a cairn there.
